DEPARTMENT OF FORESTS AND WILDLIFE
NOTIFICATION
Delhi, the 3rd September, 2025
F. No. ID No.26849/TO(N)/TC-Felling/Transplant/2025-26/7510.—WHEREAS, an application ID No.
26849 on DPTA e-Forest portal was received by the Tree Officer (North Forest Division) from the DGM, PGCIL,
400/200 kV GIS Maharani Bagh Substation, Behlopur Khadar (In front of Sarai Kale Khan ISBT), New Delhi-
110013 for seeking permission under the Delhi Preservation of Trees Act, 1994 (Delhi Act 11 of 1994) (hereinafter
referred to as DPTA, 1994) for transplantation / felling / Pruning of 39 trees number of trees for construction of 400
KV D/C Maharani Bagh-Narela Transmission Line, New Delhi in an area of 118.2496 hectare.
AND WHEREAS, the Tree Officer (North Forest Division) after due application of mind, has sought
exemption in respect of 118.2496 hectare area (as per details in Annexure – A) under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994
from applicability of Section 9 sub-section (3) of the DPTA, 1994, in view of limitation of maximum one hectare area
for considering application of tree transplantation / felling / Pruning by the Tree Officer in Section 9 sub-section (3) of
the DPTA, 1994.

[PART IV DELHI GAZETTE : EXTRAORDINARY 11

THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, the Lt. Governor of
National Capital Territory of Delhi, hereby, in public interest, exempts an area of 118.2496 hectare (as per details in
Annexure – A), from the limitation of maximum one hectare area under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of the said Act
for construction of 400 KV D/C Maharani Bagh-Narela Transmission Line, New Delhi with the following conditions:
1) This notification is being issued under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994 only to exempt the 118.2496
hectare area (as per details in Annexure – A) from the limitation of maximum one hectare area
under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of the DPTA, 1994 for the construction of 400 KV D/C Maharani
Bagh-Narela Transmission Line, New Delhi as sought by the Tree Officer.
2) This notification for exemption under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, in any case, shall not be
considered as permission for transplantation / felling / Pruning of trees under the DPTA, 1994.
3) The application for transplantation / felling / Pruning of tress shall be considered and scrutinized
independently and separately by the Tree Officer (North Forest Division) under the provisions of the
DPTA, 1994, the Delhi Preservation of Trees Rules, 1996, relevant guidelines, directions issued in
this regard and all relevant court orders with due application of mind minimizing the number of
affected trees to be transplantation / felling / Pruning from within the exempted area.

By Order and in the Name of the
Lt. Governor of National Capital Territory of Delhi,

SANDEEP KUMAR, Principal Secy.
